source.name: CPI Health sub-group index (base 2012=100)
source.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
source.caveat: Two monthly press releases, not a time series. The deflator is the ratio of the all-India combined Health sub-group index between January 2018 and December 2025, both read off base 2012=100. December 2025 is where it stops because the January 2026 release rebased the series to 2024=100, and splicing the two needs a linking factor rather than a division. Every rupee the cost model states is therefore a December 2025 rupee, and is that much behind the present.
source.document: CPI press releases of 12 February 2018 and 12 January 2026, Annexure I, sub-group 6.1.02 Health, all-India combined.

readings.label: January 2018
readings.why: midpoint of the NSS 75th round field period

readings.label: December 2025
readings.why: last month published on base 2012=100 before the 2024=100 rebase

note: Multiply a rupee figure measured in the NSS 75th round by `factor` to state it in December 2025 rupees. Health prices rose 53.6% over that span.
